items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Per operator go-ahead (2026-10-23): the five Dependabot action bumps (#195-#199) are applied as one change. 11 uses: lines in codeql.yml, security.yml and test.yml move to the new pinned SHAs with version comments. The CodeQL action pins are untouched.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Each SHA was resolved independently from the release tag via the GitHub API (annotated tags dereferenced) and matches Dependabot's. Release dates: checkout v7.0.1 2026-07-20, setup-node v7.1.0 2026-10-08, upload-artifact v7.0.2 2026-10-07, create-or-update-comment v5.0.0 2025-10-02, lcov-reporter v0.4.0 2024-05-29, all past the 7-day cooldown. Breaking changes reviewed: Node 24 runtimes (GitHub-hosted runners qualify); checkout v6 stores persisted credentials in a separate file, and no workflow pushes (the e2e checkout already sets persist-credentials: false); setup-node v5 auto-caching only applies with a packageManager field, and cache: 'npm' is set explicitly anyway; upload-artifact v7 is ESM plus an opt-in archive:false; lcov-reporter v0.4.0 moves node12 to node20 and adds an optional working-directory input.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: All workflow YAML parses; git diff -U0 shows only uses: lines changed; every uses: is pinned to 40 hex characters with a version comment. PR CI (test.yml) exercises checkout, setup-node, upload-artifact (coverage) and lcov-reporter. codeql.yml and security.yml are workflow_dispatch-only (the PR 'Analyze' checks come from GitHub default setup), so both are dispatched manually on the branch. create-or-update-comment is gated on pull_request events and cannot run until that trigger is enabled (corrected after code review).
